verdict.rationale: AMD's Instinct docs list AMD SMI as a first-party "unified user-space tool to manage and monitor GPUs and drivers," and Spur as an AI-native, Slurm-compatible job scheduler. Both suggest official tooling a user operates directly, but the evidence never explicitly calls either one a command-line interface. missing for 10: explicit documentation that AMD SMI or Spur is a CLI, a command reference, any evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
